meta_title: Costume inspiration — The Lord of the Rings
meta_description: Inspiration, guides and tips for costumes for the Battle for Middle-earth. External tutorials, photo galleries and advice from the organisers.
title: Costume inspiration
subtitle: A growing collection of inspiration, photos and guides — from your first costume as a newcomer to atmospheric finishing touches for veterans.
intro: This page grows with the community. You'll find links to trusted external tutorials, photos from past years, recommendations from the organisers, and over time our own tutorials and videos.
h_accessories: Accessories — caps, leg wraps, simple shoes
h_tips: Tips and tricks from the organisers
wip_body: This page is being filled with content gradually. We're planning: photo galleries by army, video tutorials, our own material reviews, fabric-dyeing examples, and guides on making necklaces and jewellery.
